# Tube and rail fares

 Prices for pay as you go, caps and Travelcards when you travel on the Tube, DLR, London Overground, Elizabeth line and National Rail services. 

## 2026 prices

- Adult caps and Travelcard prices

...

## Peak and off-peak times

We charge higher fares at the busiest times of the day. Peak and off-peak fares are charged based on the time you touch in.

### Using pay as you go

On Tube, DLR, London Overground, Elizabeth line and National Rail services in London:

- Peak fares - Monday to Friday (not on public holidays) between 06:30 and 09:30, and between 16:00 and 19:00
- Off-peak fares - at all other times and if you travel from a station outside Zone 1 to a station in Zone 1 between 16:00 and 19:00, Monday to Friday

All Tube and Elizabeth line journeys to and from Heathrow Airport are charged peak fares if they start, end or go through Zone 1.

If you're travelling on London Overground between Euston (National Rail station) and Watford Junction:

- Peak fares - from Watford Junction towards Euston (Southbound), Monday to Friday between 06:30 and 09:30 (not on public holidays). From Euston towards Watford Junction (Northbound), peak fares apply Monday to Friday between 16:00 and 19:00 (not on public holidays)
- Off-peak fares - at all other times

...

Our Night Tube and London Overground Night Service fares are always off-peak.

Title: Single fare finder - Transport for London
URL: https://tfl.gov.uk/fares/find-fares/single-fare-finder
Published: N/A
Author: Transport
Highlights:
# Single fare finder

Find the cost of a journey between any 2 stations on Tube, DLR, London Overground, Elizabeth line and National Rail services where pay as you go (contactless or Oyster) is accepted.

Fares between 2 stations may vary depending on the line used, the direction of travel, time of day and day of the week.

Single fare finder only shows the cost of a single rail journey. Our caps and Travelcards tool shows the prices of caps and Travelcards for journeys within London zones 1-9.

Oyster is only valid for journeys within the Oyster pay as you go area shown on the map. Always check that Oyster is accepted for your entire journey before you travel.

For journeys outside the London zones, check the National Rail website for the prices of caps and Travelcards.

Published: N/A
Author: Transport
Highlights:
# Stations Fare Zone List

 Request ID: FOI-0992-1819 Date published: 25 July 2018 

## You asked

I was hoping you would be able to provide me with a list of all underground and rail stations within the London Fare Zones, with their corresponding zone? Ideally this would be provided as a .csv or Excel document. 

## We answered

Our Ref: FOI-0992-1819

Thank you for your request received on 9 July 2018 asking for a list of stations with their corresponding zone.

Your request has been considered in accordance with the requirements of the Freedom of Information Act and our information access policy. I can confirm we do hold the information you require. 

Please find the requested information attached.
